theme_short: Design, discovery and the tools you didn't know you needed
theme: **Design, discovery and the tools you didn't know you needed.** Two design skills teach your AI real taste, while a GPU speed unlock and an AI tutoring platform show that the most useful tools solve problems you may not have known you had.
method: **How this week was picked:** 221 candidates from 4 of 6 sources (GitHub Trending, Trendshift, Hacker News, findarepo). skills.sh returned a 401 (leaderboard data retrieved via fallback for Claude Board update only). YouTube was not scanned (no pre-scan file for Oct 30). GitHub search found candidates only (not an independent source). 14 cleared all floors. Picks: 6 by score, 3 new this week (under 45 days), 1 still climbing (over 90 days). **Every repo passed our safety check on Oct 30.** Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model settled PASS by routine (activity flag only - 40 watchers on 52K stars; suspicious star pattern noted as watch-out). No repos taken down this week from the re-check. Tips: none this week (data/tips.md empty).
